title: President Curtis Season 1 Episode 5 ending explained: Did Curtis manage to defeat the ancient witch?
How Saudi-French ties are turning an ancient oasis into a new canvas
description: article author: Nada Alturki Tue, 2026-08-25 01:52 RIYADH: In January, a fantastical scene took place between the valleys of AlUla: French highliners dotted the sky in a suspenseful performance, while Compagnie de Chaillot acrobats and children from the AlUla community down below moved together, building on the idea of transcendence. This was a performance at Wadi AlFann as part of the programming for AlUla Arts Festival under Villa Hegra, put on by Rachid Ouramdane, Nathan Paulin and Christophe Chassol, the creative minds behind Vertige (Vertigo). title: The sunhat is everywhere in Athens as crowds grow larger at ancient Greek sites
description: ATHENS, Greece — Outside the Acropolis, a sea of hats bobs up and down the hill to the ancient site: straw boaters, Panama hats, baseball caps and bucket hats in the relentless heat.
